connector.name: TONNode - TON blockchain access
connector.registryDescription: Liteserver access to TON: balances, account state, transactions and get-methods over native ADNL.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tonnode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: TON_LITESERVERS
env.description: Optional JSON array of private liteserver entries: [{"ip":"host","port":41000,"key":"<base64 ed25519>"}]. Defaults to the public global config.

env.name: TON_NETWORK
env.description: Set to "testnet" to use the testnet global config.
